description: This is a 3D model of a spiral staircase with a landing, attached to a simplified building facade. The staircase is made of light-colored wood, featuring treads and a railing composed of vertical spindles and horizontal supports. The building facade behind it is white and shows the cast shadow of the staircase. The staircase is positioned on a dark grey tiled platform. The overall presentation is clean and minimalist, likely intended for architectural visualization or a 3D asset library. The design suggests an outdoor or fire escape style staircase.
